definitions.gloss: illustration by example; exemplification; proof by example
definitions.explanation: Demonstrating or proving something by providing concrete examples. Used in academic, logical, and argumentative contexts.

examples.japanese: {具体的|ぐたいてき}な{例証|れいしょう}を{挙|あ}げる。
この{理論|りろん}は{多|おお}くの{例証|れいしょう}によって{裏付|うらづ}けられている。
examples.english: This theory is supported by many examples.

examples.japanese: {歴史的|れきしてき}{事実|じじつ}を{例証|れいしょう}として{示|しめ}しながら{論文|ろんぶん}を{展開|てんかい}した。
examples.english: The paper developed its argument by presenting historical facts as examples.

notes: Composed of {例|れい} (example) + {証|しょう} (proof, evidence). A formal/academic term used in writing and argumentation. Common collocations: {例証|れいしょう}を{挙|あ}げる (to cite an example as proof), {例証|れいしょう}する (to illustrate/exemplify), {例証|れいしょう}として (as an illustration). Not to be confused with the homophone {冷笑|れいしょう} (sneer, cold smile). Related terms: {実証|じっしょう} (empirical proof), {論証|ろんしょう} (logical proof), {立証|りっしょう} (establishing proof).
